profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an MIT graduate with a BS in Computer Science and Engineering and a minor in Statistics and Data Science, with a passion for solving complex problems. I have experience in many areas, including Full-Stack development, Deep Learning, Hardware Architecture, Game Development, and Project Management.

I have gained valuable hands-on experience as a full stack developer and a software engineer intern at MIT and Microsoft, respectively. At MIT, I designed and optimized a web-based visual editor for recognizing systemic bias, using React.js and Node.js, and increasing speed by 20%. At Microsoft, I built and deployed features in .NET for the Universal Human Relevance System (UHRS) Team, delivering user-friendly features that enable interaction with millions of AI-generated images and prompt suggestions for an AI image generator. I also engaged in cross-functional collaborations, and led technical reviews. I am comfortable applying my adaptive skills and problem solving abilities to any situation.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and optimized a new web-based visual editor for recognizing systemic bias 
- Planned, authored, and revised new features in React.js, increased speed by 20%
- Conducted robust testing and bug finding across multiple platforms and browsers; debugged, provided feedback, and completed documentation for presentation
- Optimized back-end processes in Node.js, thus enabling new functionality
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Full-Stack Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Node.js · Debugging · React.js · Code Review

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Built and deployed two projects in .NET through the entire software development life cycle for the Universal Human Relevance System (UHRS) Team
- Planned, designed, implemented, and deployed a new History Page that enables interaction with millions of AI-Generated Images, thus adding user functionality
- Delivered a user-friendly feature that enables usage of prompt suggestions for an AI image generator that is currently in use by the Microsoft community
- Built and optimized full-stack code in .NET via C#, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
- Engaged in cross-functional collaborations for integrating, testing, debugging, and deploying new features in a large-scale architecture that resolved over 100 errors
- Led technical presentations on project status and final product delivery
- Created testing suites for seamless future integrations
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · .NET Framework · JavaScript · User Experience (UX) · HTML · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · C# · Debugging · Code Review · Front-end Development

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated on a tool to generate music in real-time using ML/AI
- Designed, coded, tested, and validated JavaScript pipelines for machine learning on music databases to significantly improve efficiency and achieve real-time speed
- Authored new UI/UX and sound design features in React.js
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · GitHub · User Experience (UX) · Machine Learning · Software Design · React.js · Front-end Development

positions.title: Explore Internship | Product Manager & SWE
positions.description:
- Successfully built and deployed an open-ended project from scratch for Bing
- Updated a machine learning image recognition model from C++ to C# and .NET, and created new modules for image processing pipelines utilized by millions of users
- Improved scalability and removed 80% of manual effort required for maintenance
- Managed manual deployments, created test sets using Python, and conducted stress testing and data analysis to support millions of users
- Led a team through Agile project lifecycle, peer reviews, and technical presentations
- Led team training sessions on relevant project concepts, including machine learning
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C++ · Microsoft Azure · Data Structures · Project Management · Computer Science · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · C# · Software Design · Code Review · Communication · Visual Studio · Product Management

positions.title: Technology Services Worker
positions.description:
- Assisted with new Technology Deployment at campuses. 
- Set up computer and peripheral equipment.
- Installed, supported, updated, and troubleshot software and hardware. 
- IT asset management and documentation. 
- Setup software systems for specialized technology programs.

positions.title: Guest Experience Specialist
positions.description: Provided customer service to movie theater guests. Responsibilities included greeting and directing guests, ticketing, concessions, and working in a team environment.

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute 2020 Student
positions.description: Participated in a four-week introduction to computer science program that provided instruction on HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Completed code-along sessions, and developed multiple projects including games, simulations and animations.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Computer Science · HTML · Communication · Visual Studio

positions.title: Computer Science Club President
positions.description: As a member of the Computer Science club, I participated and placed in multiple school events and competitions, using the Java programming language. From 2019 to 2020, as club president, I ran meetings, lessons, and activities, and served as a mentor and tutor to members.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Team Leadership · Computer Science · Communication · Visual Studio

projects.title: Spam Filter Machine Learning Project
projects.description:
- Developed a text classification machine learning infrastructure in Python  
- Coded pre-processing and evaluation infrastructure for converting samples into useful data structures, maximizing data efficiency
- Tested and documented multiple methods to improve model effectiveness and achieve high accuracy over thousands of samples, and determine tradeoffs
- Utilized multiple ML tools to compare and document different methods and models.

projects.title: Rat Pack Game
projects.description:
- Worked with a team to conceptualize and build a multiplayer game in Unreal Engine
- Responsible for creating sound design and composing music via Logic Pro and Audition
- Developed robust blueprints and C++ code; designed, tested, debugged, and finetuned player controls and gameplay mechanics
- Utilized an Agile development lifecycle, and maintained team communication to assign tasks, issue tracking, debug errors, document progress, and meet deadlines
